note: Printed facts `datasets/marvelsdb/` does not record, and cards it does not have. Read by tools/Marvel.Cards.Extract, which is the only thing that writes datasets/cards/cards.json. Every group says why it is here: a supplement nobody can audit is a place for a made-up number to live. Core-set entries are checked against English printed cards; expansion entries remain unchecked until expansion work begins.

groups.why: The English printed Fear No Evil card spells Daredevil correctly in the damage cost; the pinned MarvelSDB text contains Daredeveil.

cards.text: Hero Action: Exhaust this card and deal 1 damage to Daredevil → choose: • Choose any upgrade from the [[Sense]] deck and play it, ignoring its resource cost. (Do not shuffle.) • Ready Daredevil.

groups.why: Wrecking Crew English card illustration on official FFG rules insert page 3 identifies Piledriver as the villain whose presence keeps Pile It On! in play. The upstream transcription names Wrecker instead.

cards.text: Piledriver's Side Scheme. This card cannot leave play while Piledriver is in play. Pile Drive — Forced Response: After threat is placed here, if there is 10 or more threat here, each player discards the upgrade or support they control with the highest cost. Remove all but 3 threat from this scheme.

groups.why: A printed stat modifier on an attachment or an upgrade -- the small `ATK +1` in the stat box, which `rr:attachment.1` makes declarative. MarvelSDB records one for most of the 170 cards that carry one and not for these.

cards.authority: English Core Set scan, Concussion Blasters (Under Attack 3/5): https://marvelcdb.com/bundles/cards/01153.png

groups.why: A character whose stat box prints a value MarvelSDB leaves out. Every one is a villain stage that prints a dash or a special value where a number goes; the game reads a dash as zero.

A stat box whose printed value is not a number. `rr:hit-points` gives every character a hit point total; these four villain stages print an infinity glyph, and upstream records the glyph as zero -- which is a character already defeated.
`rr:boost-boost-icon` -- boost icons are printed on the card's back and MarvelSDB records them per card. These carry icons it has no value for.
An identity the card names in a sentence MarvelSDB's text does not carry -- `Give to the [name] player`, `[name]'s Side Scheme`.
MarvelSDB records Burning Hunger and its boost icons but omits its entire printed text box. The directly inspected English card image supplies the identity target and both trait branches.

cards.text: Give to the Jean Grey player. When Revealed: If you have the [[UNLEASHED]] trait, search the encounter deck, discard pile, and set-aside area for Dark Phoenix and reveal her. Then, remove Burning Hunger from the game. If you have the [[RESTRAINED]] trait, remove 1 power counter from Phoenix Force and this card gains surge. Discard this card.

groups.why: A keyword the card prints and MarvelSDB's text box does not say. `rr:keywords.1` puts them at the top of the box, and these are missing from the transcription rather than from the card.
`rr:trait` -- traits are game text and cards match on them. MarvelSDB records none for these.

cards.authority: English Core Set scan, Whiplash (Iron Man Nemesis 2/5): https://marvelcdb.com/bundles/cards/01172.png

groups.why: A card MarvelSDB does not have. The status cards are not printed cards at all -- `rr:status-card` has the game make them -- and the generic minions and allies are the same: `Reveal.EnterPlay` needs a face for `put a minion into play` when no printed card is named. The Challenge cards and the two rule inserts are the campaign expansions' own components.

cards.name: Form Flippers

cards.name: Flower Power
cards.text: Defeat the Ronan the Accuser villain as the Groot hero. Groot must be at full health and possess the Power Stone at the end of the scenario.

cards.name: Breakin' and Takin': Ultimate Edition
cards.text: Defeat the Rhino villain while including the following modular encounter sets: Infinity Gauntlet, Flight, Super Strength, and Telepathy.

cards.name: Absorbing the Elements
cards.text: Defeat the Absorbing Man villain while the following characters are in play (as heroes or allies): Groot, Iceman, Rockslide, and Colossus.

cards.name: Gene Pool Party
cards.text: Defeat the Unus villain using only heroes with the ‘Pool aspect, one of whom must be Phoenix.

cards.name: Need for Speed
cards.text: Attack the Speed Demon minion three times in one turn with the Quicksilver hero.

cards.name: Whose Show is it Anyway?
cards.text: Defeat the Mojo villain as the Spider-Ham and/or Deadpool hero(es). During this scenario, Show environments cannot leave play (ignore their “When Revealed” effects).

cards.name: Wrath of the Mad Titan
cards.text: Defeat the Thanos villain using only Avenger and/or Guardian heroes. The final blow can only be dealt by a hero with 1 remaining hit point. After completing setup, advance the main scheme to stage 2A.

cards.name: Complete the Collection
cards.text: Win the Infiltrate the Museum scenario as any hero(es). During this scenario, players cannot remove cards from The Collection, and The Grand Collection main scheme no longer causes players to lose when there are 5 per player cards in The Collection.

cards.name: Symbiote Smackdown
cards.text:
Defeat the Venom villain with the Venom Nemesis encounter set as the modular encounter set.
Only the Venom hero, Web-Warrior heroes, or heroes with “Spider” in their title can be used. After setup, each player searches their collection for a Symbiote Suit and puts it in play under their control, then searches the encounter deck for an Enraged Symbiote and reveals it.
During this scenario, each Symbiote Suit gains permanent, and each Enraged Symbiote triggers the villain’s Forced Response when attacked.

cards.name: Fickle Crowds
cards.text: Defeat MaGog as any hero(es). During this scenario, at the end of each villain phase, move 1 per player ratings counters from The Challengers to The Champion.

cards.name: Everyday Heroes
cards.text: Win any scenario as any hero(es) without any identities flipping to hero form (each player must stay in alter-ego form for the entire game).

cards.name: Mystic Mayhem
cards.text: Defeat Ebony Maw using the Adam Warlock Nemesis and the Doctor Strange Nemesis encounter sets as modular encounter sets. Only Mystic heroes can be used for this scenario. At the end of each villain phase, first player reveals the top card of the encounter deck.

cards.name: Lock and Load
cards.text: Defeat Crossbones using the Osborn Tech, Goblin Gear, and Military Grade modular encounter sets (remove Experimental Weapons). During setup, shuffle four random Weapon cards from these modular sets together to form the Experimental Weapons deck. Shuffle the remaining cards into the encounter deck as normal. For this scenario, only heroes with Weapon or Armor identity-specific upgrades may be used.

cards.name: Lone Wolf
cards.text: Defeat Stryfe solo as any hero with no allies in your deck (replace any identity-specific allies with aspect/basic cards). During this scenario, whenever you defeat a minion, draw 1 card.

cards.name: Field Study
cards.text: Defeat Dark Beast using the Temporal modular encounter set. Each player must use a hero whose alter-ego has the Genius trait. During this scenario, whenever a minion is revealed, resolve the “Special” ability on the Setting environment.

cards.name: Battle of the Bots
cards.text: Defeat Ultron as any hero(es) using the Sentinels modular encounter set. During this scenario, Drone minions gain the Sentinel trait, and Sentinel minions gain the Drone trait.

cards.name: Not Easy Being Green
cards.text: Win the Risky Business scenario using only heroes from the following list: She-Hulk, Hulk, Gamora, and/or Drax. Each hero deck must use the Protection aspect for this scenario. During this scenario, if there are ever 6 per player or more infamy counters on Criminal Enterprise, the players lose the game.

cards.name: The Wreckoning
cards.text: Win the Wrecking Crew scenario as any hero(es). After setup, search each encounter deck for the following attachments and reveal them: Magic Crowbar, Ball and Chain, Distracting Taunts, and Bulldozer’s Helmet. During this scenario, each villain gains +1 SCH and +1 ATK for each defeated villain.

cards.name: Absolutely Zero Tolerance
cards.text: Win the Project Wideawake scenario using the Future Past modular encounter set. Players can only use X-Men heroes for this scenario. After setup, search the encounter deck for Bastion and deal him to the first player as a facedown encounter card. At the end of each villain phase, if Bastion is in the encounter discard pile or victory display, deal him to the first player as a facedown encounter card.

cards.name: Boss Rush
cards.text: Defeat the Hela, Taskmaster, and Mister Sinister scenarios, in that order. Players do not reset the game state between each scenario; instead, as soon as one scenario is won, remove all encounter cards from the game (except for Captive allies) and replace them with those of the next scenario, then resume play from the beginning of the player phase. During these scenarios, if any hero is defeated, the players lose the challenge.

cards.text: When Revealed: Deal 1 damage to each identity. Forced Interrupt: When Bloody Mary would be defeated, place 1 damage token on Disturbed Psyche instead and reset her hit points to 13[per_hero].

cards.name: Disturbed Psyche
cards.text: Setup. Setup: Put the villain into play on a random side (and reveal it). Forced Interrupt: When the villain phase ends, flip the villain. If there are 3 or more tokens here, the players win the game!

cards.name: Establish Trust
cards.text: Permanent. Setup. [star] In expert mode, this card gains hinder 3[per_hero]. When Defeated: Place 1 threat token on Disturbed Psyche. Flip this card.

cards.name: Mary Walker
cards.text: Attach to the villain. Permanent. [star] Attached villain cannot activate. Forced Response: After the villain takes damage or the round ends, deal each player 1 facedown encounter card and flip this card.

cards.name: Telekinesis
cards.text:
Attach to the villain. Hero Action: Spend [mental] [mental] resources → discard this card.
[star] Boost: If Typhoid Mary is activating, take 3 indirect damage. Exhaust each character damaged this way.

cards.name: Psionic Slash
cards.text:
When Revealed: If the Mary Walker attachment is in play, flip it and reveal Establish Trust. The villain schemes.
[star] Boost: If Typhoid Mary is activating, deal 3 damage to an ally you control.

cards.name: Psi Nova
cards.text:
When Revealed: Deal 1 damage to each character you control. You are stunned.
[star] Boost: If Typhoid Mary is activating, you are stunned.

cards.name: Assembled Armor
cards.text:
Attach to the villain. Forced Interrupt: When the villain would take any amount of damage, place it here instead. Then, if there is 5 or more damage here (8 or more in expert mode), discard this attachment.
[star] Boost: If Bloody Mary is activating, you are confused.

cards.name: Hail of Blades
cards.text:
When Revealed: If the Mary Walker attachment is in play, flip it and reveal Establish Trust. The villain attacks you (even if you are in alter-ego form).
[star] Boost: If Bloody Mary is activating, take 2 damage.

cards.name: Scavenged Bulwark
cards.text:
Surge. When Revealed: Give the villain a tough status card.
[star] Boost: If Bloody Mary is activating, give her a tough status card.

cards.name: Hand Lookout
cards.text:
Guard. Toughness.
[star] Boost: Give the activating enemy an additional boost card.
